arguments.query: SELECT region_code, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id)) pay, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shp, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) ref FROM orders o GROUP BY 1
SELECT payment_status, count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(*), count(DISTINCT s.order_id) shp FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(*) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, count(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-S' AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1
